description: This file defines the implementation of the AIConfiguration class, which manages configuration parameters for AI-related features in a software system. It includes methods for reading configuration data from a file, parsing JSON arrays, and printing configuration details.

classes.name: AIConfiguration
classes.description: Class responsible for managing AI system configuration, including reading from config files, parsing JSON data, and providing accessors for configuration parameters.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the configuration by reading from the configuration file.

methods.name: getContainerConsoleLogCap
methods.description: Returns the console log capacity.

methods.name: getAppsCpuSet
methods.description: Returns the CPU set for applications.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppMemoryLimit
methods.description: Returns the memory limit for non-home applications.

methods.name: getNonHomeAppGpuLimit
methods.description: Returns the GPU memory limit for non-home applications.

methods.name: getVpuAccessBlacklist
methods.description: Returns the list of VPU access blacklisted applications.

methods.name: getAppsRequiringDBus
methods.description: Returns the list of applications requiring D-Bus.

methods.name: getMapiPorts
methods.description: Returns the list of MAPI ports.

methods.name: getResourceManagerClientEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the resource manager client is enabled.

methods.name: getGstreamerRegistryEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether GStreamer registry is enabled.

methods.name: getSvpEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether SVP is enabled.

methods.name: getEnableUsbMassStorage
methods.description: Returns whether USB mass storage is enabled.

methods.name: getIPv6Enabled
methods.description: Returns whether IPv6 is enabled.

methods.name: getIonHeapDefaultQuota
methods.description: Returns the default Ion heap quota.

methods.name: getDialServerPort
methods.description: Returns the dial server port.

methods.name: getDialServerPathPrefix
methods.description: Returns the dial server path prefix.

methods.name: getDialUsn
methods.description: Returns the dial USN.

methods.name: getPreloads
methods.description: Returns the list of preload libraries.

methods.name: readGlobalEnv
methods.description: Reads and returns the global environment variables.

methods.name: getEnvs
methods.description: Returns environment variables specific to the configuration.

methods.name: getIonHeapQuotas
methods.description: Returns Ion heap quotas as a map.

methods.name: readFromCustomData
methods.description: Populates configuration parameters with default custom data values.

methods.name: parseStringArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON string array into a list of strings.

methods.name: parseIntArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON array of integers into a list of ints.

methods.name: parseIonLimits
methods.description: Parses a JSON object into a map of Ion heap quotas.

methods.name: printAIConfiguration
methods.description: Logs the current configuration parameters for verification.

methods.name: readFromConfigFile
methods.description: Reads configuration parameters from the specified ini file and parses them.
